title: The Heist, the Mice and the House

intro.line: Akul didn't know what lay inside Tarnation's great vault, but the mystery fueled his obsession.
Three very different places, one after another: a western with a vault, a valley of animal folk, and a house that is alive.

finale.line: As the vault collapsed around them, Kellan made sure Akul couldn't follow them out.
Valgavoth is destroyed. The survivors walk out of the House into daylight, and the story goes on without him.
Recorded: a heist, a valley and a house, and the survivors of all three.

villainFinale.line: Within the silken shroud, all doubts are cleansed, and all desires are united with Valgavoth.
In this version, the house eats everyone, and you were afraid.

battles.title: Plot the Job
battles.blurb: Oko's crew plans a heist on the Tarnation vault. The Hellspur gang wants it too.

scene.line: Sure it's risky, but that's what makes it fun! That and the money. And the bankers' faces.
Kind of them to put all their valuables in the same place.
Plot: a card that is plotted is exiled with the plan and cast later for free. Do the thinking now and pay for it on a later turn.

villainScene.line: Every moving carriage is an accident waiting to happen, and the Hellspurs hate waiting.
Crackling with rage and stolen thunder, he drives the Hellspurs to ever-greater heights of violence.

hero.half: Plot a spell now, cast it free later.

battles.title: Small Heroes
battles.blurb: The vault is empty and so are Kellan's hopes. Akul wants a word. Kellan has a lot of tiny friends.

scene.line: I found out who I was. Now it's time to discover who I am.
Never underestimate what a rabbit can do with a root vegetable and some moxie.
Offspring: pay extra and get a small 1/1 copy of the creature along with it. Two bodies for one card.

villainScene.line: Akul saw his Hellspur followers as little more than ammunition to be expended.
The last fool who called him "cowboy" earned a free ride to the bottom of Blacksnag Bog.

hero.half: Pay the offspring cost for a second body.

battles.title: Every Door
battles.blurb: Mabel and her mice take a house with doors that lead to doors. The Calamity Beasts have a vote in this too.

scene.line: We sought adventure and found calamity. Forward, so we may meet both with courage!
"You stole a child from its nest," Mabel accused. "The only calamity I see here is you."
Rooms: a Room has two doors. Cast one half, then pay to unlock the other later. Two rooms, one card.

villainScene.line: Its wingspan reaches from dusk to dawn.
When Glarb ordered the egg stolen, the Great Maha communicated its anger in a universal language.

hero.half: Cast one half now, unlock the other later.

battles.title: The House Is Hungry
battles.blurb: Tyvar has come to the House of Duskmourn. The House has come for Tyvar.

scene.line: They just keep coming and coming—perfect for my morning workout!
Be on your guard. Valgavoth has eyes everywhere. And I don't mean that figuratively.
Hit hard and fast. The house gets stronger the longer you let it feed.

villainScene.line: Valgavoth wants our pain, our terror! We cannot join him unless we suffer!
Hope and reliable lighting are in short supply in the House. Glimmers provide both.

battles.title: Survival
battles.blurb: Winter leads survivors through the ghost rooms. Staying alive is the only plan.

scene.line: That's the one good thing about these cultists: sometimes they do your work for you.
Thanks, but no thanks. I'm done with hope.
Survival: if your creature is tapped after attacking, it triggers at your second main phase. Attack, then enjoy the extra effect.

villainScene.line: Valgavoth commands us to feed the trees. Let our blood be their mulch, our flesh their soil.
On the second day after he'd been separated from his friends, Tino worried they'd be panicking at his absence. By the fourth, he was certain they'd never cared for him at all.

hero.half: Attack to tap, then collect the survival trigger.

battles.title: Boros Mice vs Golgari
battles.blurb: Autumn 2024: tiny Boros aggro against a Golgari midrange deck full of removal.

scene.line: Fear is unavoidable. You can run from it with your tail between your legs, or charge it head on with sword in hand. I prefer the latter.
No battle is fought, or won, alone.
Be fast. Their removal is better than yours, so end the game before they stabilise.

villainScene.line: "Should we act now or later?" the rat asked. "Both," whispered the squirrel.

battles.title: Dimir vs Izzet Prowess
battles.blurb: Autumn 2024: Dimir midrange against a fast Izzet prowess deck.

scene.line: Kaito's blade brought the light of another plane into Duskmourn, and with it, a brief chance to escape.
It scours battlefields for corpses, consuming flesh and souls alike.
Kill their early creatures and counter the tricks. You win the long game.

villainScene.line: Oh? Do I need to repeat myself?

battles.title: Valgavoth, Terror Eater
battles.blurb: The house is alive and it is hungry. The heist crew and the survivors have to leave it with fewer rooms than it started with.

scene.line: Clad in the light of conviction and hope, Linette strode forth to face Duskmourn's terrors without fear.
The vault's ultimate prize wasn't exactly what Kellan had imagined.
He feeds on fear, so stay calm. Kill the small creatures early and hit him when he finally lands.

villainScene.line: All who enter the House hear Valgavoth's whispers, worming through their consciousness until they can no longer resist his influence.
Valgavoth whispered into Marina's ear until he was all she could hear.

hero.half: Stay calm and kill the small creatures early.

half.line: Keep moving. The door is this way.

battles.title: Mono-Red Mice
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, a deck of tiny mice that wins on turn four.

archive.what: A mono-red deck of one- and two-mana mice and burn, built around Heartfire Hero.
archive.why: It was the fastest deck in the format and punished any slow draw.
archive.beat: Block early and kill the first two mice. Heartfire Hero gets out of hand if you let it.
archive.after: Later sets gave the format more removal and slowed it down.
